[EN] It never ceases to astonish me how many people desire to pass through this portal, yet fail to understand the basic criteria for admission.

Are there not loremasters where you come from? Were you taught nothing?
[ES] Jamás deja de sorprenderme cuánta gente desea cruzar este portal, pero no comprende los criterios básicos de admisión.

¿Acaso no hay historiadores en tu lugar de origen? ¿No te enseñaron nada?
